examples.name: Tags in a bounding box — SELECT, counted
examples.query:
PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>

SELECT ?tag (COUNT(?s) AS ?features)
FROM </overpass/features.rdf?bbox=11.075,49.457,11.077,49.459>
WHERE {
  ?s dc:subject ?tag .
}
GROUP BY ?tag
ORDER BY DESC(?features)

examples.name: Features with geometry — SELECT
examples.query:
PREFIX locn: <http://www.w3.org/ns/locn#>

SELECT ?s ?wkt
FROM </overpass/features.rdf?bbox=11.075,49.457,11.077,49.459>
WHERE {
  ?s locn:geometry ?wkt .
}
LIMIT 20

examples.name: Building footprint areas — geof:metricArea
examples.query:
PREFIX dc:   <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
PREFIX locn: <http://www.w3.org/ns/locn#>
PREFIX geof: <http://www.opengis.net/def/function/geosparql/>

# Ways whose first and last node coincide are emitted as POLYGON, so a
# geodesic area is defined for them.
SELECT ?s (ROUND(geof:metricArea(?wkt)) AS ?m2)
FROM </overpass/features.rdf?bbox=11.075,49.457,11.077,49.459&filter=building>
WHERE {
  ?s locn:geometry ?wkt .
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?wkt), "POLYGON"))
}
ORDER BY DESC(?m2)
LIMIT 10

examples.name: Geometry dimension per feature — fn:dimension
examples.query:
PREFIX locn: <http://www.w3.org/ns/locn#>
PREFIX fn:   <https://osmwrap.ontologycentral.com/vocab/fn#>

# 0 = point (node), 1 = curve (open way), 2 = surface (closed way).
SELECT ?dim (COUNT(?s) AS ?features)
FROM </overpass/features.rdf?bbox=11.075,49.457,11.077,49.459>
WHERE {
  ?s locn:geometry ?wkt .
  BIND(fn:dimension(?wkt) AS ?dim)
}
GROUP BY ?dim
ORDER BY ?dim

examples.name: Street lengths — geof:metricLength
examples.query:
PREFIX locn: <http://www.w3.org/ns/locn#>
PREFIX geof: <http://www.opengis.net/def/function/geosparql/>
PREFIX fn:   <https://osmwrap.ontologycentral.com/vocab/fn#>

SELECT ?s (ROUND(geof:metricLength(?wkt)) AS ?metres)
FROM </overpass/features.rdf?bbox=11.075,49.457,11.077,49.459&filter=highway>
WHERE {
  ?s locn:geometry ?wkt .
  FILTER(fn:dimension(?wkt) = 1)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?metres)
LIMIT 10
